inputs.name: Accessions & metadata
inputs.description: A CSV with one row per public-repository accession to import. fetchngs downloads the reads for each accession; the remaining columns set the identity and metadata of the Flow sample created from it once the run completes.

input.name: Import sheet
input.description: CSV with a header row and one row per accession. Columns: accession (a run SRR/ERR/DRR or experiment SRX/ERX/DRX accession), name (the sample name; defaults to the accession if blank), sample_type, organism, strandedness. fetchngs reads only the accession column; the other columns are read by Flow when it creates the samples.
